execution_rules.pre_execution_mapping: Fully map all steps/stages in priority order before initiating execution. The written map becomes the strictly authorized route.
execution_rules.route_authorization_lock: Once the execution map is created, the chosen route to the endpoint is strictly the ONLY authorized path. No unmapped steps or route deviations are permitted.
execution_rules.stage_commit_tracking: A verified git SHA must be recorded and logged upon the successful completion of each individual stage.

acceptance_criteria.success_condition: All stages executed along the mapped route with verified git SHAs recorded in the receipt file.
